_notes.basis: Proposed from warp_events dest_map topology, dimensions, NPCs and dialogue, compared with pret/pokecrystal maps/*.asm. Names follow pokecrystal where an equivalent exists, descriptive otherwise. Maps not listed keep their current name.
_notes.Johto_Route32RuinsOfAlphGate: Warps to ROUTE36 + RUINS_OF_ALPH_OUTSIDE and mapsec ROUTE 36; the text match was 1.0 only because Quetzal reuses the Route32 gate's dialogue. The real Route 32 gate is Johto_Route32_House1.
_notes.Johto_RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamber: One 26x68 map holding all four puzzle chambers (Ho-Oh top-left, Kabuto top-right, Omanyte bottom-left, Aerodactyl bottom-right, by sign positions) plus the four item rooms below them. Renamed so it is not mistaken for the Kabuto chamber alone.
_notes.Johto_RuinsOfAlph_Cave1-4: Word rooms, from the item-room hole each one connects to: Cave1 under the Ho-Oh chamber (top-left), Cave4 Kabuto (top-right), Cave3 Omanyte (bottom-left), Cave2 Aerodactyl (bottom-right). Each one also warps to the Inner Chamber, like Crystal's word rooms.
_notes.Johto_RuinsOfAlph*ItemRoom (Tin Tower): The ripper matched four TIN TOWER floors to Ruins of Alph item rooms because of shared item-ball text. The warp chain matches Crystal's Tin Tower exactly: 1F > Cave1(2F) > Cave2(3F) > Aerodactyl(4F) > Cave3(5F) > Cave4(6F) > HoOh(7F) > Omanyte(8F, 5 warps to 9F) > Kabuto(9F, warps to roof).
_notes.Johto_TinTower_Area2 / Johto_MtSilver_Ar: Alternate-layout headers. Scripts swap between the pair with setmaplayoutindex (Tin Tower roof 0x293/0x294 via QZ_SPECIAL_704; Silver summit 0x231/0x232 and Dept Store roof 0x1FE/0x1FF on FLAG_QZ_0x1016). Only one of each pair is reached by warps. For the roof, the reachable map is Johto_GoldenrodCity_House2 (DeptStore6F warp 2), so that one becomes GoldenrodDeptStoreRoof.
_notes.Unreferenced duplicates: Johto_IlexForest_Area1, Johto_Route34_Area1, Johto_Route34_House1, Johto_GoldenrodCity_Area1 and Johto_GoldenrodCity_House6 (35.118-35.122) have no events, no warps and nothing references them. They reuse the layouts of IlexForest, Route34, Route34IlexForestGate, GoldenrodCity and the Goldenrod Pokemon Center (layout 0x208 = Johto_GoldenrodCity_PokemonCenter_1F1). Johto_LakeOfRage_Area1 is likewise an unreferenced Lake of Rage header with layout 0x21E. Suffixed _Copy/_Alt; it is probably safe to drop them.
_notes.Johto_MtSilver_Cave5 -> SilverCaveRoom3: Last cave before the summit, by topology. Unlike Crystal, RED stands outdoors on the summit (Area3/Area4, Quetzal_EventScript_83E05E8), not in Room3.
_notes.Johto_MtSilver_Area1 / Area2: Descriptive. Area1 = outdoor mountainside off Room1 (three warps, Jirachi). Area2 = snowy outdoor slope between Room2 and Room3 (Calyrex, Articuno). No Crystal equivalent.
_notes.Johto_MtSilver_Cave2: Unsure. A 35x35 side room off Room1 with Fire-type encounters plus Moltres and Heatran. Suggested name: SilverCaveFireRoom.
_notes.Johto_WhirlIslands_Cave1: All four Route 41 island entrances (Crystal's WhirlIslandNW/NE/SW/SE) merged into one 60x60 map, so it gets a descriptive name.
_notes.Johto_WhirlIslands_Cave3/4/5: Unsure. A chain B1F > Cave3 (30x30) > Cave4 (70x27) > Cave5 (70x27, Manaphy and Nihilego) > B2F, with no Crystal equivalent. Suggested names: WhirlIslandCave (Cave3; Crystal's WhirlIslandCave also hangs off B1F), WhirlIslandB3FWest and WhirlIslandB3FEast (Cave4/5).
_notes.Johto_VictoryRoad*: Three floors instead of Crystal's single map: Gate > Cave2 > Cave1 > VictoryRoad > IndigoPlateau_Area2. Named 1F/2F/3F in walking order (HGSS-style).
_notes.Johto_IndigoPlateau_Area1/Area2: Johto has its own Indigo Plateau. Area1 (24x20, outside of the Pokemon Center) and Area2 (24x160, from Victory Road to the plateau) have the same sizes as Kanto_IndigoPlateau_Exterior and Kanto_Route23. Crystal folds both into Route23, so Area2 = Route23 and Area1 = IndigoPlateau. If both regions keep their names, add a region prefix (the Johto_ folder prefix already avoids the clash).
_notes.Johto_Route26 / Route26_Area1: Quetzal splits Route 26: Area1 (39x81, south, both houses, connects to Route 27) and Johto_Route26 (39x30, north, the Victory Road Gate, connects to Route 28). Crystal has a single Route26 map.
_notes.Johto_Route35NationalParkGate: 50x18. Crystal's Route35 and Route36 National Park gates merged into one building (warps to Route35, Route36, NationalPark and NationalParkBugContest). The ripper's name is kept; NationalParkGates would be more accurate.
_notes.Johto_Route40_House1 -> Route40TrainerHi: Inference. A gate on Route 40 (entered at 11,13, left at 10-12,5) just south of the connection to Trainer Hill, in the spot where Crystal has Route40BattleTowerGate. It is empty.
_notes.Johto_TrainerHill_Cave1: Unsure. An empty 21x20 room off TrainerHillOutside. Suggested name: TrainerHillEntrance. No battle facility scripts are present.
_notes.Johto_EcruteakCity_Area1 / EcruteakCity_: Area1 is the north part of Ecruteak (70x69, connected above EcruteakCity) with the Tin Tower entrance (HGSS Bell Tower grounds); named EcruteakCityNorth for want of a better name. House1 is the empty room linking EcruteakTinTowerEntrance to Area1, the role of Crystal's WiseTriosRoom (which links the city and EcruteakTinTowerEntrance). The Wise Trio NPCs are not in it.
_notes.Johto_TohjoFalls_Cave2: Descriptive. A small room inside Tohjo Falls where postgame GIOVANNI (Lv100, TRAINER_QZ_4191) waits and the Celebi alternate-past trip starts. No Crystal equivalent.
_notes.Johto_SafariZone*: The area names come from each area's wild encounter table: Area3 desert mons, Area4 plains, Area7 beach (ocean route), SafariZone_Area1 forest/jungle. Unsure about two: SafariZoneGate_Area5 (OCEAN_ROUTE; Clefairy, Lunatone/Solrock, Bagon, Druddigon and Dratini on water; probably the 'rare dragon' area, maybe SafariZone_Peak) and SafariZoneGate_Area6 (Meowth, Purrloin, Glameow, Komala, Morpeko...; maybe SafariZone_Savannah). Area2 has no encounters; it is the path from the entrance building into the hub (Area4).
_notes.Johto_CianwoodCity_House1: Unsure. An old woman who talks about the Clear Bell and Tidal Bell (HGSS-style). Crystal's Cianwood house with an old woman is PokeSeersHouse, but the seer's dialogue is not here.
_notes.Johto_OlivineCity_Area1 -> OlivineCityPi: Descriptive. A 32x23 ocean-route strip south of Olivine (connected below it) with the warp into OlivinePort. Crystal has no outdoor map for it.
_notes.Johto_BlackthornCity_House2 -> MoveDelet: An empty 13x10 house; Blackthorn's sign for it reads "MOVE BROS' HOUSE" (move relearner/deleter, presumably handled in code). Crystal name used.
_notes.keys: Keys are the folder names of the rip regenerated on 2026-10-25, which renamed some placeholders (e.g. the old Johto_GoldenrodCity_House5 is now Johto_GoldenrodCity_House4). Because placeholder names can move again, _group_num gives each key's Quetzal map group.num, which does not change; match on that if a key is missing.
_notes.Ripper role names: In the regenerated rip several maps are called *_PokemonCenter_1F*, but some of them are not Pokemon Centers. Johto_NewBarkTown_PokemonCenter_1F1/1F2 are the player's house (MOM heals you; 2F has the bed, NES and clock) and Johto_RuinsOfAlph_PokemonCenter_1F1 is the Research Center (fossil revival and a shop). CherrygroveCity, GoldenrodCity, MtSilver and SafariZoneGate _PokemonCenter_1F1 are real Pokemon Centers (nurse and PC).
